content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD MODULE TIME_SPECTRA_MODULE (L82-L459): 'a wavemaker module for time-dependent spectra' @L57 (HISTORY 01/10/2024 Fengyan Shi @L60). Header comments L62-L77 document the call structure across io.F/main.F/mod_tide.F/sponge.F for WaveMaker='TIME_SPECTRA' (TIME_SPECTRA_INITIAL, TIDE_INITIAL, TIME_SPECTRA_PROTECTION, then per-timestep TIME_SPECTRA_INTERPOLATION feeding ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC). USEs PARAM @L83, GLOBAL spectral/wavemaker names L84-L91, TIDE_MODULE @L92, INPUT_READ @L94, GLOBAL myid,ier,npx,npy,PX,PY,iista,jjsta @L95, MPI @L96; IMPLICIT NONE @L97, SAVE @L98. Four subroutines. (1) TIME_SPECTRA_INITIAL (L115-L227): READ_STRING 'SPECTRA_FILE' @L134 (missing => MPI_FINALIZE+STOP L139-L140); OPENs unit 400 @L149-L150; reads title and bin-count header lines, NumFreq,NumDir @L157; ALLOCATEs Amp_Ser/AmpData1/AmpData2/Per_Ser/Theta_Ser/Phase_LEFT/Segma_Ser/Wave_Number_Ser/Theta_2D (L158-L162) and Cm/Sm eta,u,v arrays (Mloc,Nloc,Numfreq) (L163-L165); reads frequency bins as frequency then inverts to period Per_Ser(J)=1.0_SP/Per_Ser(J) @L171; direction bins converted deg->rad @L177; reads Phase_Data flag @L181 — 1 => Phase_LEFT matrix read (L183-L185) and deg->rad with literal 3.1415926 @L188, else random phases rand(0)*2.0_SP*3.1415926 @L195; reads first 'time, file name' pair TimeSpectra2/NameSpectra2 (L203-L204), copies to *1 (L206-L207); OPENs unit 401 @L215-L216 and reads first amplitude matrix AmpData2 (L218-L219), CLOSE @L224. (2) TIME_SPECTRA_PROTECTION (L229-L257): STOPs unless TIDAL_BC_GEN_ABS (L235-L244) and TideBcType(1:4)=='DATA' (L246-L255). (3) TIME_SPECTRA_INTERPOLATION (L259-L343): when TIME exceeds both stored times, shifts *2 into *1 (L270-L272), reads next TimeSpectra2 from unit 400 with IOSTAT (EOF => GOTO 120 @L278), NameSpectra2 @L280, opens unit 401 and reads AmpData2 (L290-L295); linear time interpolation tmp2=(TimeSpectra2-TIME)/MAX(SMALL,ABS(TimeSpectra2-TimeSpectra1)), tmp1=1.0_SP-tmp2 (L309-L311), Amp_Ser=AmpData2*tmp1+AmpData1*tmp2 @L315; label 120 @L317; updates Dep_Ser=TideWest_ETA+Depth(1,1) @L319 and CALLs CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm_TIME @L321; commented-out debug block L326-L341 (references PrecRateModel). (4) CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm_TIME (L345-L456): one-time (SAVEd flags Not_done_wavenumber/Not_done_periodic init .TRUE. @L354) wavenumber solve per frequency — Segma_Ser(I)=2.0*pi/Per_Ser(I) @L361, initial guess from long-wave celerity sqrt(Grav*Dep_Ser) @L362-L364, Newton iteration (labels 55 @L367 / 65 @L374) on dispersion Fk=Grav*k*tanh(k*Dep_Ser)-sigma^2 with derivative Fkdif (L369-L370), update k=k-Fk/Fkdif @L371, tolerance 1.0e-8 or Iter>1000 @L368 — and one-time periodic-direction adjustment (CalcPeriodicTheta @L385 when PERIODIC, else copy @L388); then zeroes Stokes_Drift_Ser @L394 and Cm/Sm arrays (L398-L403), sets Zlev=ABS(1.0_SP+Beta_ref)*Dep_Ser @L405, and in loops KK(freq)/KKK(dir)/J/I computes maker coordinates X_maker=(I-Ibeg+(iista-1))*DX @L414, Y_maker @L415 and accumulates directional-sum cosine/sine transfer arrays: Cm_eta/Sm_eta from Amp_Ser*COS/SIN(k*(sin(theta)*Y+cos(theta)*X)+phase) (L418-L423) and Cm_u/Cm_v/Sm_u/Sm_v with linear-theory factor Segma_Ser*cosh(k*Zlev)/sinh(k*Dep_Ser) times COS/SIN(Theta_2D) (L424-L447).

verbatim_spans.text: 120 CONTINUE  ! no more data for vessel Kves

unresolved: CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm_TIME periodic block (L380-L392) loops DO KK=1,NumFreq @L382 / DO KKK=1,NumDir @L383 but assigns Theta_2D(I,KKK) @L386/@L388 using I (module-level loop variable from GLOBAL) instead of KK — only row I of Theta_2D is written while the accumulation loops read Theta_2D(KK,KKK) @L419 etc.; cross-line defect L382-L391 vs L418-L447

Label 120 @L317 (EOF target from @L278) is placed before the Dep_Ser update @L319 and the CALL @L321, so after spectra data runs out the code still recomputes Dep_Ser and Cm/Sm each step while Amp_Ser update @L315 is skipped; comment @L317 mentions 'vessel Kves' — copied from a vessel module
tmp1/tmp2 both remain ZERO when TIME <= TimeSpectra1 (L300-L313), making Amp_Ser=0 @L315 before the first spectra time instead of holding AmpData1

Dep_Ser @L319 uses Depth(1,1) — the local (per-processor, ghost-corner) depth cell, so Dep_Ser differs across MPI ranks and from the physical wavemaker location; also Newton wavenumbers (L358-L378) are computed once (SAVEd flag) with the then-current Dep_Ser and never updated though Dep_Ser changes each call

Phase conversions use literal 3.1415926 (L188, L195) while pi/PI from PARAM is used elsewhere (L177, L361); rand(0) @L195 is a compiler extension and per-rank reproducibility/synchronization of random phases across MPI ranks is not established in this file

Per_Ser is loaded with frequency then inverted @L171 — after L171 Per_Ser holds periods; Amp_Ser is indexed (KK=freq, KKK=dir) while the input matrices are read as (row=direction, implied-do over frequency) @L184/L219/L292 — consistent internally but transposed relative to file layout

Unit 400 (spectra index file) is opened @L150 and never closed in this file; unit 401 is reopened/closed per amplitude file; locals SpectraName @L122, WHAT after reads, rII,rJJ @L264, K @L348, tmp_eta,tmp_u,tmp_v @L352, myvar @L109, Fact @L395, NameSpectra1/TimeSpectra1 usage after L270 shift are declared/assigned but partly unused
